subject: Delivery Criteria & Acceptance Drumline — MAP proposal for Horizon Health evaluation

Subject: Delivery Criteria & Acceptance Drumline — MAP proposal for Horizon Health evaluation

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciate the clear product hooks you described. Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v0.3.xlsx) and a short acceptance evidence template (acceptance-evidence-template.md) to make the evaluation concrete. Thought it would help to call out a compact "acceptance drumline" — a short list of success checks we agree to run at each milestone so signoff is objective and fast.

High-level proposal (3-week evaluation):
- Week 1: Kickoff + baseline smoke tests (connectivity, auth, basic latency). Goal: platform reachable and test harness runs end-to-end.
- Week 2: Feature validation + quality sampling (10 representative prompts, concordance targets). Gate: pass 8/10 concordance or remediate.
- Week 3: Load and resiliency + data controls verification (throughput run, failover, KMS/VPC checks). Final gate: production-readiness checklist and evidence bundle.

Suggested success criteria (examples):
- Latency: p95 generation < 250ms for 64-token responses under baseline traffic (see test plan).
- Quality: token-level concordance >= 92% on agreed sample set; no critical hallucination cases in top-10 prompts.
- Stability: 99.5% request success over a 30-minute throughput run at target qps.
- Security: documented SOC 2 artifacts + KMS key rotation proof for the test workspace.

Acceptance tests (short list):
1) Connectivity & auth smoke (2 hrs) — run harness, verify token auth, prefixes cached.
2) E2E accuracy sample (4 hrs) — run 10 probes, record scored results in evidence template.
3) Throughput ramp (1 day) — ramp to target qps, track p95 and error rate.
4) Failover/patch simulation (2 hrs) — verify fallback model variant and region routing.
5) Data control verification (half day) — confirm VPC peering, KMS logs, and retention policy applied.

Owners: can you confirm who at Horizon will own evidence collection (name + email)? I suggest Alex Turner for procurement/contract side and someone on the engineering team for test ownership.

Deliverables we will provide: MAP workbook (attached), acceptance-test-plan.md (stub), and a shared evidence folder. If this looks good we can lock in a kickoff next Tuesday (2026-11-09) and shift the timeline if you need more runway.

Attachments: MAP-v0.3.xlsx (MAP workbook), acceptance-evidence-template.md (evidence checklist)

Next steps: confirm owners + preferred kickoff date, and whether SOC 2 artifacts are required up front.

Thanks,
Camila

Thanks — quick technical notes and proposed pass thresholds so the acceptance drumline is unambiguous.

Acceptance-test-plane (high level):
- Connectivity & Auth smoke:
  * Verify OAuth token exchange and service account access within 30 minutes.
  * Evidence: successful auth logs, screenshot of token call trace.
- E2E accuracy sample:
  * 10 agreed prompts; scoring: pass if >= 8/10 meet concordance threshold.
  * Concordance metric: normalized token precision over reference responses; target >= 92%.
  * Evidence: CSV of prompts, outputs, human score column, and script used.
- Throughput ramp:
  * Ramp to target qps (TBD by Horizon) over 1 hour; measure p50/p95/p99 and error rate.
  * Target: p95 < 250ms and error rate < 0.5% at target qps.
- Failover simulation:
  * Trigger model-variant fallback and region routing; validate response continuity with <2x latency delta.
- Privacy smoke (per Maya):
  * Run a synthetic PHI payload through non-prod workspace; verify redaction hooks and presence of audit log entries.
  * Evidence: audit log extract, config snapshot showing KMS key id and retention config.

Notes: we can provide SOC 2 pointer (redwood.com/security/soc2) and a redacted artifact pack before the security gate. For the test harness we will share acceptance-test-plan.md and a Jenkins/GH Actions job you can run in your environment.

Attachments: acceptance-test-plan.md (short test steps)

I'll update the MAP workbook with these thresholds and re-upload. Camila — can you confirm you want the kickoff on 2026-11-16?

Thanks,
Karthik
